meta.name: full-output-enforcement
meta.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制生成完整代码，禁止占位符截断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到LLM输出被截断或出现占位符的问题
copy.tagline_en: Force complete code generation, ban placeholder truncation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face LLM output truncation or placeholder issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会强制按要求交付全部内容：用户要几个文件、组件或章节就完整给出几个，不许用省略号、TODO 等占位符；接近 token 上限时会在完整段落处暂停并提示继续。
howto.when: 任务要求完整、未删节的输出（如整个文件、指定数量的组件等）时触发；输出接近 token 上限时也会启用暂停续写机制。

say.text: 完整写出这个文件的所有代码，不要省略任何部分。
say.note: Claude 会按完整输出模式执行，不省略内容。

say.text: 给出5个模块的完整实现，禁止用骨架或占位符。
say.note: Claude 会逐模块完整生成，满足数量要求。

say.text: 从刚才暂停的断点继续，不要重新开始。
say.note: Claude 会直接接着上次停止处输出。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude delivers all requested content in full: if the user asks for N files, components, or sections, all N are fully produced. Placeholders like ellipses, TODO, or 'rest of code' are banned. When nearing the token limit, it pauses at a clean breakpoint and prompts to continue.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task demands exhaustive, unabridged output (e.g., a full file, a specified number of components, etc.), and also when the response approaches the token limit to enable the pause-and-resume mechanism.

say_en.text: Output the full code of this file, with no omissions.
say_en.note: Claude follows full-output mode and stops omitting content.

say_en.text: Provide complete implementations for all 5 modules, no skeletons or placeholders.
say_en.note: Claude generates each module fully and meets the count.

say_en.text: Resume exactly from the paused breakpoint, no restart.
say_en.note: Claude picks up from where it stopped.
